subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The `options` object passed to `contentstack.Stack(options)` does NOT include a `live_preview` configuration block. The prescribed root-cause fix requires adding `live_preview: { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, preview_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN }` to the options. Without this, the Contentstack SDK never processes live preview data — every downstream component is starved of preview content. This is the root cause identified in the RCA and it remains completely unaddressed.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview: { enable: true, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN }` to the `options` object (around line 48-68), following the existing env-var pattern used for `CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST`. Also add the corresponding env var destructuring at the top of the file.

issues.description: The file exports a bare `createContext<IContentstackContext>({})` with NO Provider component, NO `useState`, NO `useEffect`, and NO `onEntryChange`/`onLiveUpdate` subscription. The prescribed client-side fix requires a `ContentstackProvider` component that initializes the Live Preview SDK and subscribes to `onEntryChange` events, merging incoming preview data into context state via `setContent`. Without a reactive Provider, the `useContent` hook (consumed by 236+ components) always returns the static SSR-provided default content. No real-time preview updates can ever reach any consumer. All acceptance criteria related to real-time/draft content display are unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a `ContentstackProvider` component that: (1) replaces the static context with `useState` for `content`; (2) adds a `useEffect` that calls `LivePreview.init()` and subscribes to `onEntryChange` (or `onMessage`); (3) merges incoming preview entry data into existing content state via `setContent`; (4) wraps children with `<ContentstackContext.Provider value={...}>`. Import `@contentstack/live-preview-utils`.

issues.description: The `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` dependency is not installed anywhere in the project. No import of this package exists in the codebase. Without this SDK, no client-side WebSocket-based Live Preview subscription can be established, making real-time content updates impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` to package.json dependencies and install it. Import it in the ContentstackProvider component.

issues.description: `ICommonContentstackConfig`, `ICreateQueryConfig`, and `ICreateEntryConfig` interfaces were not updated with an optional `live_preview` parameter. The prescribed fix requires adding an optional `live_preview` field so that live preview hash data can flow through to Contentstack queries. Without it, queries will always return published content even if the Stack is configured for live preview.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: { hash?: string; url?: string }` (or equivalent) to `ICommonContentstackConfig` or to both `ICreateQueryConfig` and `ICreateEntryConfig`.

issues.description: `createContentTypeQuery` and `createContentTypeEntryQuery` do not call `query.includeFallback()` or pass `live_preview` context to the Contentstack query chain. Even if the Stack were initialized with live_preview config, queries will always return published content because the live_preview hash from URL params is never forwarded to the query.
issues.suggestedFix: In `setCommonConfig` or in `createContentTypeQuery`/`createContentTypeEntryQuery`, check for a `live_preview` config field and if present, call `query.includeFallback()` and pass the live_preview hash to the query chain.

issues.description: `useContent` calls `useContext(ContentstackContext)` but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return the static value passed at render time. Even if Contentstack live preview events fired, there is no state setter to trigger re-renders of the 236+ consumers. The hook cannot propagate live preview updates as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: This is fixed implicitly by creating the `ContentstackProvider` with `useState` (see blocker on contentstackContext.tsx). Once the Provider supplies a reactive value, `useContent` will work without changes — but only if the Provider is actually implemented.

issues.description: No `pages/api/preview.ts` route exists to enable Next.js draft mode. Without this, `getStaticProps` will not re-run on CMS edits and the live preview session cannot be established server-side. No `context.preview` or `context.previewData` is forwarded to Contentstack service calls in any page component.
issues.suggestedFix: Create `src/pages/api/preview.ts` that calls `setPreviewData` with the live_preview hash/token. Update `getStaticProps` in page components (e.g., `src/pages/[[...slug]].tsx`) to forward `context.preview`/`context.previewData` to `getSingleEntry`/`getEntry`/`findSingletonEntry` calls.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. There is no `test/unit/` directory at all. No tests mirror `src/context/` for a ContentstackProvider, no tests for `live_preview` config in Stack options, no tests for `includeFallback()` behavior, and no tests verifying reactive content updates via `onEntryChange`. The test count has not increased to cover this new feature, violating the requirement that new features have corresponding vitest unit tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Create vitest test files mirroring the src/ paths: `test/unit/services/contentstack.spec.ts` (verify live_preview in options), `test/unit/context/contentstackContext.spec.tsx` (verify Provider subscribes to onEntryChange and updates state), and `test/unit/hooks/useContent.spec.ts` (verify hook returns updated content when Provider state changes).
